cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Delegate Downward
cards.instruction: Make someone accept an unwanted responsibility by placing them lower in the hierarchy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. You're my deputy. You'll answer the inspector's complaints.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Most of them concern decisions you made.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Exactly. You handle the details below decision-making level.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The inspector wants whoever signs the replies at tomorrow's hearing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sign as deputy, then. You can represent me without giving the impression we're equals.

mechanism: A uses a former trainee subordinate status to transfer inspection replies and resulting hearing attendance away from itself.
confusable: Not merely delegating a task: A rejects decision-level equality to make B own the consequences.
comparison: Late premises duty versus official representation burden.
seedUse: D53 inspector/decisions/signature/hearing; S05 complaint-writing training as warrant for downward delegation.
